allow: PowerShell(if \($env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\) { "Key found in environment" } else { "No key in environment" })

PowerShell($bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\(".env.local"\); Write-Host "First 3 bytes \(BOM check\):" \($bytes[0..2] -join ","\); $content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText\(".env.local"\); Write-Host "Content length:" $content.Length; $lines = $content -split "`n"; foreach \($line in $lines\) { if \($line -match "ANTHROPIC"\) { Write-Host "Key line length:" $line.Length; Write-Host "Starts with:" $line.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(20, $line.Length\)\) } })
PowerShell($env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = \(Get-Content ".env.local" | Where-Object { $_ -match "^ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=" } | ForEach-Object { \($_ -split "=", 2\)[1] }\); npm run research-seasons)
